rows: Assumption to be checked against the chamber booking log. Leon and Paride to confirm which chambers are shared with the ICH work and which are dedicated.
Charged per pull per condition, not per sample. Pulls at 40 °C/75% RH and 30 °C/65% RH are priced the same as 25 °C/60% RH on the current list.
Storage-month rate (GBP): not agreed. Confirm against the commercial rate record before quoting; no numeric rate entered here.
Priced per method. Re-validation after a method change is not covered by the list price.
